name: @reconlion/parseltongue-capsule-cli
description: Human-operable CLI for local secure message capsules. Holds all passphrase and plaintext handling.
comment:boundary: This CLI exists as a SECURITY BOUNDARY, not for convenience. Passphrases and decrypted plaintext are handled here and never in an MCP tool, because an MCP tool argument or result travels through the model context and the session transcript.
